name: Double Knee to Chest Stretch
steps: Lie on your back on a mat with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Bring one knee to your chest, followed by the other knee.
Wrap your arms around your shins or the backs of your thighs.
Gently pull both knees in toward your chest until your lower back gently flattens and rounds off the floor.
Hold the stretch for 20 to 30 seconds while taking slow, relaxed breaths.
Carefully lower one foot at a time back to the floor.
coaching_cues: Keep your neck relaxed; do not strain or pull your chin to your knees unless guided.
Hold behind the thighs if you have sensitive knees.
Relax your lower back muscles completely into the stretch.
